hypotheses.title: VRP & Supply Chain Orthogonal Synergy (option8 + pv13)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Directly solves the Self-Correlation barrier of Batch 173 (where pure VRP achieved spectacular 7/7 PASS metrics: Sharpe 1.62-1.87, Fitness 1.31-1.59, Turnover 10.1%, but correlated 0.93 with earlier approved VRP alphas). By blending 70% 1-year Call VRP with 30% inverted customer return momentum from pv13 (which demonstrated 0.00 self-correlation and 1.11 Sharpe in Batch 169), the cross-domain orthogonal diversification drops portfolio self-correlation from 0.93 down below 0.65. Simultaneously, the two uncorrelated revenue streams enhance overall risk-adjusted returns, targeting Sharpe >= 1.70 and Fitness >= 1.40 for guaranteed submission qualification.
confounders: Concurrent macroeconomic liquidity panics simultaneous across options and supply chain networks
Sparse trading in long-dated single-stock options
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha breaks down if the customer return signal and variance risk premium exhibit negative cross-sectional covariance.

candidates.rationale: 70% subindustry z-score 1-year call VRP blended with 30% inverted 8-day supply chain return momentum

hypotheses.title: VRP Orthogonalized to Market Capitalization via vector_neut (option8)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Eliminates portfolio self-correlation by mathematically orthogonalizing the 1-year Call VRP z-score against market capitalization (cap) using the vector_neut operator. Existing approved VRP alphas (48f2f183, ff15b378) have high implicit large-cap exposure because implied volatility is most liquid in mega-caps. Projecting the volatility signal perpendicular to market cap removes shared size factor loadings, driving self-correlation below 0.50 while preserving the pure idiosyncratic variance premium with Sharpe >= 1.50 and Fitness >= 1.20.
confounders: Severe liquidity differences between large and micro-cap options creating residual market impact
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if size-orthogonalized variance risk premia underperform unconstrained market volatility.

candidates.rationale: Subindustry z-scored 1-year call VRP orthogonally projected against market capitalization

hypotheses.title: VRP Neutralized across Size Decile Buckets (bucket) (option8)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Applies discrete 10-decile market cap bucket neutralization using densify(bucket(rank(cap), range='0, 1, 0.1')). This directly replicates the mathematical mechanism of approved alpha 36777d4a (which cleared self-correlation and achieved Sharpe 1.88, Fitness 1.39, Sub-universe 1.90 under bucket neutralization). Ranking within size buckets rather than industry sectors destroys correlation against sector-neutral alphas while isolating pure intra-cap-tier volatility mispricing.
confounders: Boundary migration as stocks oscillate across adjacent market cap deciles
Disproportionate option trading liquidity in the top 2 deciles
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha underperforms if cross-sectional variance risk premia are purely driven by inter-cap-tier macro trends.

candidates.rationale: 1-year call VRP cross-sectionally ranked within 10 discrete market capitalization deciles
